clubs.name: ACM Student Chapter
clubs.tagline: Advancing Computing as a Science & Profession
clubs.blurb: A student community for computing research, education and practice, bringing learners together through coding competitions, technical workshops, design sprints, research discussions and hackathons.
clubs.description: The ACM Student Chapter is one of BMU's largest student communities. Its activities span coding competitions, technical workshops, design sprints, research discussions, hackathons and interdisciplinary showcases. In 2025, it received an Honorable Mention for Best Emerging Student Chapter, launched a dedicated Research Wing and introduced an automated attendance system through TrACMe.

clubs.name: Agraga – The HR & IR Club
clubs.tagline: People, workplaces and the future of work
clubs.blurb: A community exploring human resources, industrial relations, workplace culture and people-focused leadership through discussions, activities and collaborative learning.
clubs.description: Agraga brings students together to explore how people, teams and organisations work. The club's activities can include conversations on workplace culture, talent management, industrial relations, leadership and professional development.

clubs.name: Automobile Club
clubs.blurb: A space for automotive enthusiasts to explore vehicle technology, mechanical systems, mobility trends and hands-on engineering ideas.
clubs.description: The Automobile Club connects students interested in cars, bikes and mobility engineering through technical discussions, vehicle showcases, design challenges and explorations of automotive technology.

clubs.name: Blaze
clubs.blurb: A performance community for students who enjoy dance, choreography, stage expression and collaborative routines.
clubs.description: Blaze is imagined as a high-energy dance community where students can learn choreography, practise different styles, collaborate on performances and take the stage at campus events.

clubs.name: BMU Robotics Club
clubs.tagline: Build it. Code it. Bring it to life.
clubs.blurb: A hands-on community exploring robotics, automation, embedded systems and intelligent machines through collaborative projects.
clubs.description: BMU Robotics Club brings together makers and technology enthusiasts to experiment with robots, sensors, electronics, control systems and automation through practical builds and technical challenges.

clubs.name: Culinary Club
clubs.blurb: A community for food lovers to explore cooking, culinary creativity, food culture and shared experiences.
clubs.description: The Culinary Club celebrates food through cooking sessions, tasting experiences, recipe experiments and events that bring people together around different cuisines and culinary traditions.

clubs.name: Enactus BMU
clubs.blurb: A student community focused on entrepreneurial action, social innovation and sustainable solutions to real-world challenges.
clubs.description: Enactus BMU encourages students to identify community challenges and develop entrepreneurial projects that aim to create sustainable social and economic impact.

clubs.name: Finonomics Club
clubs.blurb: A community exploring finance, economics, markets, business news and practical financial literacy.
clubs.description: Finonomics Club gives students a platform to discuss economic ideas, financial markets, investing concepts, business trends and the forces shaping the global economy.

clubs.name: Insights Club
clubs.blurb: A student community for analytical thinking, research, problem-solving and making sense of information.
clubs.description: Insights Club brings curious students together to explore data, research, business problems and structured decision-making through discussions, case activities and collaborative projects.

clubs.name: LIQuID
clubs.blurb: A creative space for students interested in literature, language, discussion, writing and the exchange of ideas.
clubs.description: LIQuID is presented as a platform for literary expression and thoughtful conversation, with opportunities for writing, reading, spoken-word activities and discussions across perspectives.

clubs.name: Mrityunjaya – The Theatre Society
clubs.blurb: A theatre community exploring acting, direction, stagecraft, storytelling and live performance.
clubs.description: Mrityunjaya brings together students who enjoy theatre and storytelling, creating opportunities to develop acting skills, work behind the scenes and stage productions for the campus community.

clubs.name: Nazariya
clubs.tagline: See the world from another frame
clubs.blurb: A creative community exploring cinema, visual narratives, photography, filmmaking and thoughtful media expression.
clubs.description: Nazariya offers a space for students to explore visual storytelling through film appreciation, creative projects, screenings, photography and conversations about the stories images can tell.

clubs.name: NSS BMU
clubs.blurb: A volunteer community focused on social responsibility, community engagement and service-led initiatives.
clubs.description: NSS BMU encourages students to contribute to society through volunteering, awareness campaigns, community outreach, environmental activities and service initiatives.

clubs.name: PAC – Photography & Cinematography Club
clubs.blurb: A community for photographers and filmmakers to learn visual techniques, experiment with equipment and tell stories through images and video.
clubs.description: PAC brings together students interested in photography and cinematography through photo walks, filmmaking exercises, editing sessions, visual challenges and creative collaborations.

clubs.name: PFA – The Performing Arts Club
clubs.blurb: A platform for students to explore performance, music, dance, theatre and other forms of creative expression.
clubs.description: PFA celebrates performing arts by creating opportunities for students to practise, collaborate and perform across a range of artistic disciplines at campus events and showcases.

clubs.name: SATA – Science and Technology
clubs.blurb: A student community for exploring scientific ideas, emerging technologies and practical innovation.
clubs.description: SATA encourages curiosity about science and technology through knowledge-sharing sessions, demonstrations, collaborative projects and conversations about new developments.

clubs.name: SAVERA
clubs.blurb: A community-oriented club encouraging awareness, inclusion, volunteering and positive action on campus and beyond.
clubs.description: SAVERA is presented as a student platform for community participation and social awareness, bringing people together around initiatives that support a more informed and caring society.

clubs.name: Sci-Mat
clubs.blurb: A welcoming community for curious minds passionate about science, technology and innovation, connecting theoretical knowledge with real-world applications.
clubs.description: Sci-Mat offers a platform to learn, explore and connect across scientific and technological interests. Its profile highlights Open.Sourcery, which recorded 200+ paid registrations and was described as the club's highest paid-registration record.

clubs.name: Sierra
clubs.blurb: A community for students interested in outdoor experiences, exploration, adventure and shared challenges.
clubs.description: Sierra is presented as an adventure-oriented student community that can bring people together through outdoor activities, exploration, team challenges and experiences beyond the classroom.

clubs.name: SMC – Social Media Club
clubs.blurb: A creative community exploring digital storytelling, social platforms, content strategy and online communication.
clubs.description: SMC gives students a space to experiment with social media content, creative campaigns, digital trends, branding and community engagement across online platforms.

clubs.name: Strokes
clubs.blurb: A creative community for artists and designers to experiment with visual art, illustration, craft and creative expression.
clubs.description: Strokes brings together students who enjoy making and sharing art, with opportunities to explore different media, develop visual skills and collaborate on creative displays.

clubs.name: TSEC – The Startup and Entrepreneurship Club
clubs.blurb: A community for aspiring founders and innovators to explore entrepreneurship, business models, pitching and startup culture.
clubs.description: TSEC encourages entrepreneurial thinking through ideation activities, startup conversations, pitch practice, founder interactions and opportunities to develop early-stage ideas.

clubs.name: Wellness Tribe
clubs.blurb: A supportive community promoting wellbeing, healthy habits, balance and positive campus experiences.
clubs.description: Wellness Tribe is presented as a space to encourage conversations and activities around wellbeing, mindfulness, healthy routines and building a supportive student community.

clubs.name: YRC – Youth Red Cross
clubs.blurb: A student volunteer community centred on humanitarian values, health awareness, first aid and community service.
clubs.description: YRC encourages students to participate in service-oriented activities and awareness initiatives, with a focus on compassion, health, preparedness and helping communities.
